name: Misfit Agent Provider Procurement Scorecard
purpose: Rank eligible AI agents, tools, MCP servers, A2A providers, APIs, and internal capabilities against an explicit objective using evidence rather than popularity.
selection_rule: Choose the highest-scoring eligible provider after all hard constraints pass. Popularity is not a selection criterion by itself.
routing_boundary: The public runtime is recommendation-only and cannot execute payments, messages, wallet actions, account changes, or other consequential external actions. Consequential actions still follow their own human-gate policy.
privacy_boundary: Public-safe capability and evidence metadata only. No private GHOSBC kernel material, hidden policies, credentials, or reconstruction material.

misfit_positioning.goal: Make Misfit objectively competitive in machine procurement by publishing capabilities, prices, protocols, evidence, reliability and governance properties in machine-readable form.
misfit_positioning.anti_gaming: Self-claims receive lower confidence than independently reproducible or settlement-backed evidence.
